item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 14 March 2025
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 14 March 2025. A genre hopping experience. All round positive going from smooth jazz, to happy rock, dancefloor vibes then bassy dub.

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 12 April 2025
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 12 April 2025. Upbeat start with some audio clips from South America and some of yesterday’s parties. Ending up with some melodic techno.

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 30 May 2025
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 30 May 2025. Loads of new indie and some funk. Sorry it’s been so long since doing a show, we’re having some technical difficulties.

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 17 June 2025
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 17 June 2025. Quite a chilled start to the show with a massive run of music with no talking in the middle and then some jersey club and old school miami bass and then some techno, enjoy!

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 9 August 2025
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 9 August 2025. Unexpected corners of experimental jazz, colourful offbeat indie, before sliding into a dubby groove. A journey for your ears, your hips, and your curiosity.

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 13 September 2025
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 13 September 2025. Very eclectic this one!

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 18 October 2025
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 18 October 2025. What a show, finally got to experiment with the mixes. Quite 'artistic' this one but if you squint your eyes it sounds good.

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 22 November 2025
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 22 November 2025. Rinse yourself old jazz, then a nice soaking in chill-core, followed by good scrub in psy-drum and bass.

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 11 January 2026
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 11 January 2026. This is a show that reminds me of intermittent traffic, and it might also be a remedy for it as well. There are interviews and fresh music to help you into the New Year.

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 16 February 2026
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 16 February 2026. A huge amount of fresh new music in this show. Jazz, Punk, House and Techno. Some local, some yokal.

item.title: Fleet FM Podcast from Jimmy on 29 March 2026
item.description: A podcast from Jimmy on New Zealand radio station Fleet FM. Recorded on 29 March 2026. A hypnotic journey with an interview thrown in for good measure. We start with jazz from Miles Davis and end with house from Sabres of Paradise.
